snippet.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! 👑 Doom Door? 📜 #games #gamer #gamers #gaming #gameshorts #gameplay #indiegames #steam
snippet.description:
Ahoy Me Matey's,

👉 Request access via the SteamPage to join the Dev's in our playtest
❤️ Wishlist the game to support development and get notified of future tests
💨 SteamPage: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1612750/YAARRGH_Battle_Island/

🚧 Welcome to our gaming universe, where the magic is still in the making! 🚧

📜 Our diggers, the geniuses they are, have burrowed so deep into the earth they struck somethin’ older than fear itself.

👑 And what do they find?  A door.  A big, ancient, ‘please-don’t-open-me’ door?  What’s behind it?  Treasure?  Cursed relics?  The Skeleton King’s mother-in-law?

💣 Who knows!  But one thing be certain, if the door starts whisperin’ back, RUN!  Leave yer boots, leave yer mates, leave yer dignity, we’ll pick it all up later.

⚓ Call to Arms:
Join the ranks of GreedyVox Indie Studio, a humble crew of two devs.  Will ye join our crew, share in the adventure, and grow with us? Hoist the Jolly Roger and embark on this epic voyage!

🌟 Fair winds, me hearties!
Don't forget to like, share, and subscribe for more tales from the pixelated seas of YAARRGH! 🏴‍☠️

💨 SteamPage: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1612750/YAARRGH_Battle_Island/
💌 Patreon: http://bit.ly/YAARRGHPatreon
🎮 Discord: https://discord.gg/GTFBgVA
